activity.notes: Ibn Tumart founded the Almohad (al-Muwaḥḥidūn) reform movement and became its spiritual and political leader, publicly claiming the Mahdi role around 1121 and organizing the movement in the High Atlas before his death in 1130. ATLAS creates the contemporary Almohad movement identity rather than projecting the later Almohad Caliphate backward before the posthumous conquests of ʿAbd al-Muʾmin.
